programme.title: The Bronx Zoo

programme.title: Maatilan pelastajat

programme.title: Koteja lemmikkiperheille
programme.desc: Pot-Bellied Pig Palace. Perhe tilaa Antoniolta possujen paratiisin. Possu nimeltään Mr. Pickles tarvitsee uuden asumuksen, mutalätäkön ja riittävästi juoksutilaa takapihalle. Suunnittelija Antonio Ballatore rakastaa eläimiä. programme.title: Lone Star Law

programme.desc: Is The Brain a snob? That seems to be the explanation for why he won't go to Waterworld with his friends. And, Arthur's a notorious joke-killer. But when he's scheduled to perform as a carnival clown, he learns how to make people laugh!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: War of the Worms/I Owe You One
programme.desc: Brain is always taking the fun out of Fern's storytelling by correcting her facts, but things gets out of hand when Fern tricks him with a fake story! Buster is always asking for favors. Will he learn the real meaning of friendship?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster's Garden of Grief/Through the Looking Glasses
programme.desc: Buster is in charge of the community garden, but it proves to be too much for just one person. Arthur can't find his glasses and has to get new ones, but the attention he is getting from these new glasses has gone straight to his head!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: D.W.'S Stray Netkitin/Bats in the Belfry
programme.desc: D.W. is panicked when a virus ruins the Read family computer. Who will take care of her virtual pet? Arthur and D.W. are thrilled when Grandma Thora lets them turn her attic into a clubhouse. But will a bat threaten their new play space?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Baby Kate is growing up! But strangely enough, the more words she learns, the less she seems to understand their dog. To boost school spirit, Arthur and his classmates form the Lakewood Pride Committee, but not everyone wants to join.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur vs. The Piano/The Big Blow-Up
programme.desc: Arthur gets stage fright during a rehearsal. Will he be able to get through his recital without any mistakes? Then, two opinionated friends butt heads! Can Francine and The Brain put aside their differences for the good of the soccer team?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. meets 13-year-old Hana, who is much older and totally cool! Is Hana D.W's new BFF? Then, Buster is convinced teachers have it easy. Can he put himself in Mr. Ratburn’s shoes to find out what it’s like to be a teacher?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Everyone loves the Bang on a Can All-Stars, a funky experimental music group that's touring around Elwood City. Everyone that is, except Binky. A new ice cream shop has just opened up across the block. Will Brain's shop be able to survive?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine and Brain are the best players on the soccer team, and they wish their teammates could take the game a bit more seriously. And then Emily really wants the sparkly ball D.W. just found, so she tells a little white lie about it.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Challenged by Fern to enter a poetry contest, Arthur and his friends each write a poem to be judged by the famous poet Jack Prelutsky. Then, Arthur and his friends develop a consuming passion for the Scare-Your-Pants-Off books.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Who ruined Dad's perfect soufflé? The only thing Arthur and D.W. can agree on is that poor Pal was an unwitting accomplice. When Muffy starts reading Mature Miss magazine, she searches for more sophisticated friends.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Grandpa Dave's Memory Album/Buster's Carpool Catastrophe
programme.desc: Grandpa Dave is moving closer to the family, but something isn't quite right--he's forgetting all sorts of things. And Muffy, Arthur and Buster are carpooling to their cooking class. Can they stop fighting and have fun?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. saves everything. But her most prized possession is a snowball from last winter. But now it’s disappeared! Then, Arthur, Francine, and Buster must do a report on ancient Rome--but can they work as a team to complete the assignment?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: I Wanna Hold Your Hand/Whistling in the Wind
programme.desc: During a shopping trip to the mall, Binky gets caught doing the uncoolest of all the uncool things in the world--holding his mom's hand! If the Tibbles are supposed to be exactly the same, why can Tommy whistle while Timmy can't?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Will Buster's friends treat him the same after they learn he has asthma? Prankster have arrived in Elwood City--just in time for the "Scare Your Pants Off" costume party! It's boys vs. girls in what becomes a great big battle of the pranks.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Is Binky Barnes really the most disgusting, nasty, horrible person on the planet, or is he just misunderstood? Next, what's got four sides and the answer to everything? Prunella's cootie catcher!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: How can Arthur prove to his parents that he's responsible enough to take care of his very own puppy? "Get a job," suggests D.W.!. Yet another personality change for D.W., who's decided that from now on, she'll be just like Arthur.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The kids and parents of Ellwood City have all pledged not to watch TV for one whole week. Can they last? Then, big, brave Binky Barnes would be toast if people ever discovered he can't sleep without a night light.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster is hurt when he learns his friends don't trust him to keep a secret. Then, the gang finds a mysterious fortune telling game at the library and gets a hint of what their futures could hold.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's just a regular day until Francine starts to feel queasy, and then throws up in the cafeteria! Now Francine is afraid to go back to school. And, Sue Ellen learns that a fast-food chain is taking over the beloved Sugar Bowl.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: D.W., All Fired Up/I'd Rather Read It Myself
programme.desc: When Ms. Morgan announces they'll be having a fire drill during preschool, D.W. wants no part of it--it sounds way too scary. Then, the Tibble Twins are better than D.W. at just about everything.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: One day, Arthur falls asleep on a bus and awakens in a strange part of town. Will he ever find his way home? Can he keep himself from crying? Next, summer vacation is over? What about all those great, fun things Arthur intended to do?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend
programme.desc: The kids capture a snake and learn that it's possibly poisonous--after it gets lost in Arthur's house! Why is Muffy interviewing for a new best friend? She and Francine are usually inseparable, but lately it seems they have less in common.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Room to Ride/The Frensky Family Fiasco
programme.desc: With Lance Armstrong’s support, Binky and his friends take to the streets to convince residents to vote for new bike safety lanes. Francine wants the Frenskys to be closer, but a weekly Family Night turns out to be harder than expected.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Grandma Thora Appreciation Day/Fern's Slumber Party
programme.desc: Arthur and D.W. are planning a surprise party for Grandma Thora. But amidst the party-planning mayhem, they forget about the guest of honor! Then, shy Fern hosts a slumber party at her mother's urging.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur Rides The Bandwagon/Dad's Dessert Dilemma
programme.desc: Woogles have their own names and personalities and they're so darned cute! And Arthur's gotta have one, especially now that everyone is collecting them. Arthur wouldn't mind if Dad's infamous dessert "experiments" remained a family secret.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Francine has a big paper over Thanksgiving, she copies from a website. There's nothing wrong with that, is there? Everyone loves the new Top Supermarket reality series on TV, except Arthur. Will it end his friendship with Buster?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Everyone loves HUGO--the new interactive whiteboard that claims to be 100% accurate. If only Mr. Ratburn knew how to use it. Mei Lin can say "hello" AND play the piano?!? Kate can't even wave!

programme.desc: Arthur, Buster, and Brain are worried when Mr. Ratburn isn't acting like himself. He's always pleased to see them, so what’s made him change? When Mr. Crosswire gets a robot butler for Father's Day, Muffy fears Bailey may be replaced.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Ann an turas sgoinneil eile, tha Hari a' dol air tòir 'map'. Tha e a' lorg scutair agus frith-rathad fhad's a tha e ga lorg, ach am bi aige air 'map' fhaighinn agus faighinn a-mach dè tha e a' dèanamh? In another 'aba-doo-be-dee' adventure, Hari goes in search of a map. He comes across a scooter and a pathway as he explores the area, but will he be able to find out what a map looks like and what it does?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein is a charaidean gann de dh’airgead, is leis nach eil ann an airgead ach pìosan beaga pàipeir le dealbhan orra, tha iad uile a’ co-dhùnadh gun cruthaich iad an t-airgead aca fhèin, is gun ceannaich iad na thogras iad. Because they are a little short of money, and considering cash notes are only little papers with drawings on them, Petit and his friends decide to create their own money and buy anything they want.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha i air leth gaothach. Tha e a’ còrdadh ri Nìp a bhith sgèith san adhar, is e air a shiabadh leis a’ ghaoith. Tha Àtaidh agus Tilidh a’ dol a chèilidh air Blor is tha e a’ sèideadh builgean mòr an urra dhaibh, airson is gun tèid acasan ri sgèith san adhar cuideachd. Tha iad a’ dol nas àirde is nas àirde is nas àirde, is tha an t-eagal air Àtaidh. It is extremely windy and Neep has a wonderful time flying through the air on a whirligig. Abney and Teal go to see Bop - who blows a giant bubble for each of them so they can join in. They go higher and higher, which Abney is not too sure about…

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: An dèidh do Phompon tilleadh bhon choille, tha Mamaidh a' mothachadh gu bheil e làn dheargannan - ach ciamar a gheibh iad cuidhteas dhiubh? After returning from the forest, Mamaidh notices that he is full of fleas, but how will they get rid of them?

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Sionnach a’ lorg dìsinn am measg stuth a chaidh a chaith gu aon taobh. Tha an dìsinn a’ còrdadh ri Comhachag agus tha e a’ dèanamh iomlaid air a shon leis an dèideag as fheàrr leis. Tha Sionnach air a dhòigh leis an dèideag ùr ach tha Comhachag ga h-ionndrainn gu mòr. Chan eil guth aig Sionnach air a toirt air ais gus an smaoinich Maigheach ghleusta air dòigh anns an toir i a’ chomhstrì gu ceann. Fox finds a giant dice in a box of discarded belongings. Owl really likes it too and decides to trade it for his favourite doll, Oehoe. Fox enjoys life with his new toy, but Owl comes to realise he made a huge mistake; he misses Oehoe so much! Fox, however, won’t give it back. Hare thinks of a cunning way to solve the stand-off.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha cuileanan aig Spot, an amoeba aig Planctan. Plankton's pet amoeba Spot has puppies.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Tha a’ chiad teirm a’ tighinn gu crìch aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche agus tha e follaiseach a-nise gu bheil comhstrì eadar cuid den luchd-obrach. Tha Ms Sharpe agus cuid de na sgoilearan aice trang ag ullachadh airson a’ Mhòid, agus chan eil cùisean idir rèidh eadar Danny agus Mrs Fullerton. As the first term comes to an end, it’s evident that tensions are building at Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche. Miss Sharpe and her pupils are busy preparing for the Mòd and it’s looking as if Danny and Mrs Fullerton are out for revenge.

programme.title: Calum: Cogadh nan Comhlan
programme.desc: Tha Calum airson a chòmhlann aige a thoirt à Glaschu dhan Òban airson blàr mòr ciùil a tha dol aig a' Mhòd Nàiseanta Rìoghail. Ach, le tòrr fharpaisean agus gainead tìde, chan eil cùisean a' dol mar bu chòir. Leis nach eil e furasda còmhlan a làimhseachadh aig na h-amannan as fheàrr, saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh leis na dùbhlain mhòra a th' air thoiseach orra... Calum aims to take his band from Glasgow to Oban for a major musical battle at the Royal National Mòd. However, with numerous competitions and time constraints, things aren't going according to plan. Managing a band is never easy even in the best of times - how will they cope with the significant challenges that lie ahead?

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A’ Chùil. Sa phrògram seo tha i a’ sireadh an “slime” as fheàrr, ach saoil dè an reasabaidh a bhios soirbheachail? An e “slime” cruasbach, “slime” a ghabhas ithe, “slime” bith-chnàmhach no “slime” molach? Choirstaidh is looking for the best slime recipe, but what will it be? Crunchy, edible, biodegradable or fluffy slime?

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke – An Còcaire Fiadhain – a’ rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha Liusaidh a’ toirt Màiri Anna dhachaigh gu dùthaich a h-òige, Shropshire, far an do thòisich a beatha an co-bhuinn ri nàdar. Tha iad a’ trusadh bhalgan-buachair nach gabh a lorg an Gàidhealtachd na h-Alba, agus a’ dèanamh picil leotha. Tha iad a’ beachdachadh air àrainneachd gu math eadar-dhealaichte bho an dachaigh an Alba le taic bho athair Liusaidh, a’ tadhal air darach a tha co-dhiù 800 bliadhn’ a dh’aois, agus a’ trusadh eidheann-thalmhainn, lus cùbhraidh a tha càirdeach do phionnd is sèids. Agus tha an còmhnaidh ùine ann airson basgaid ùir. Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke -forage for nature’s bounty. Lucy takes Mary Ann to Shropshire where she grew up and began her life in harmony with nature. They collect fungi that can’t be found in Highland Scotland and pickle them. With some help from Lucy’s dad, they visit an 800-year-old oak tree and forage for ground ivy, a fragrant herb related to mint and sage. And there’s always time for a new basket. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s to the 1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online, and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by his daughter Ruth as they go to sea on a spectacular summer's day. Along the way they encounter a large pod of dolphins who take great delight in racing their small boat. Then it’s time for fishing and chat about the formative role of fishing in Ruth’s upbringing. Anns an dàrna prògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha nighean Aonghais, Rut, còmhla ris agus iad aig muir air latha samhraidh eireachdail. Air an t-slighe, coinnichidh iad ri buidheann leumadairean-mara a tha dannsa mun eathar. Às dèidh sin, tha an t-àm ann airson iasgach agus còmhradh mun bhuaidh a bh’ aig iasgach air beatha Ruth.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Music from Mairi MacMillan, Eoghainn O'Ceannabhain & Ultan O'Brien and Blue Rose Code. Comhla ri Màiri Nicillemhaoil, Eoghainn O'Ceannabhain & Ultan O'Brien agus Blue Rose Code.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Jenna Cumming. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Jenna Cumming.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Coinneach Rankin travels to Sutherland to tackle a challenge that has inspired generations of climbers, the Old Man of Stoer. Tides, weather and the support of a new partner will all need to align in order to gain the summit of this great sea-stack. Thèid Coinneach MacFhraing a Chataibh gus feuchainn air ceann-uidhe a bheò-ghlac ginealaichean do shreapadairean, Bodach an Stòir. Feumaidh sìde, seòl na mara agus taic còmpanaich ùir uile tighinn ri chèile gus bàrr an staca aibheisich seo a ruighinn. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Cù Leis Thu? | A Puppy for Padruig
programme.desc: Peter meets some rescue dogs before making a final decision about his new puppy companion. Coinnichidh Pàdruig ri coin theasairgte mus dèan e co-dhùnadh mun chompanach ùr aige.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Tha Niall Iain Dòmhnallach air ais le sreath ùr de Mas Fhìor - an fharpais cheist far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. A' tòiseachadh le prògram sònraichte a’ Mhòid bidh Màiri NicAonghais agus John Joe MacNèill a’ dol an aghaidh Joy Dunlop agus Art MacCarmaig airson airgead a bhuannachadh airson cathrannas. Cò gheibh làmh an uachdar agus cothrom fhaighinn air an duais mhòr? Niall Iain MacDonald is back with the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Starting off with a special Mòd programme, Mairi MacInnes and John Joe MacNeil take on Joy Dunlop and Arthur Cormack for the chance to win a cash prize for charity. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Skerryvore Aig Caisteal Floors
programme.desc: Prògram sònraichte a’ comharrachadh 20 bliadhna de Skerryvore. Chùm an còmhlan ainmeil Albannach cuirm shònraichte do nam mìltean de luchd-leantainn ann an àrainn àlainn Caisteal Floors sna Crìochan. Le agallamhan leis a’ chòmhlan is caraidean agus le criomagan bhon chonsairt. A special programme to celebrate 20 years of Skerryvore. The legendary Scottish band performed an anniversary show to thousands of fans in the spectacular surroundings of Floors Castle in the Scottish Borders. Featuring interviews with band members and friends, plus concert highlights. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Julie Fleeting
programme.desc: Determined to play, nine-year-old Julie Fleeting’s life in football began with a local boys club. It was the first step in achieving a dream she didn’t even know existed. From playing professionally in America to winning multiple honours with Arsenal, and scoring more goals for Scotland than anyone else, Julie has consistently inspired, empowered and led from the front. In a story of tenacity and triumph, Julie’s journey in football is also one of family, humility and respect. Thòisich Julie Fleeting a’ cluiche ball-coise còmhla ri sgioba bhalaich aig naoi bliadhna a dh’aois, a’ chiad cheum air an t-slighe gu dreuchd nach robh i fiù’s a smaointinn a bha comasach dhith. Bho bhith a’ cluiche gu proifeiseanta ann an Ameireagaidh gu togail dhuaisean aig Arsenal sa cur barrachd thadhail do dh’ Alba seach duine sam bith eile, tha Julie air a bhith na misneachd sna h-eisimpleir fad a beatha. Ach tha a slighe ann am ball-coise cuideachd mu dheidhinn theaghlach, irisleachd agus spèis. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Mar annlann a tha na thrèat air leth, tha Abigail a' dèanamh Briosgaidean Seasaman Tahini. Glè, glè bhlasta, a' brùchdadh le deagh bhlas is teòclaid geal! For a splendid accompaniment treat, Abigail makes tahini sesame cookies. Very tasty, packed with flavour and white chocolate! In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: World Pipe Band Championships
programme.desc: Tha Catrìona NicNèill aig Farpais Chòmhlan Pìoba na Cruinne 2025. Carrie MacNeil presents Grade One performances from the 2025 World Pipe Band Championships.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Scottish Women's Premier League (BBC ALBA)
programme.desc: Live SWPL football action as Partick Thistle host city rivals Glasgow City. Commentary comes from Donna Macneill and Cheryl McCulloch. Ball-coise SWPL beò le Partick Thistle a’ dol an aghaidh Glasgow City. Aithris bho Donna NicNeìll agus Cheryl NicCulloch.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach seachdainn le sgioba-naidheachd BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Psalm 91 air a sheinn le Còisir Ghàidhlig Bhaile Ghobhainn, an laoidh 'Reul Àlainn a' Chuain' le Kathleen Ghreumach agus bidh Mairead NicSuain ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Govan Gaelic Choir sings Psalm 91, Kathleen Graham sings the hymn 'Reul Àlainn a' Chuain' and Margaret MacSween tells her personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Cidsin Granaidh Chalanais
programme.desc: Gregor takes on grannie’s recipe for rhubarb and orange jam, using his own home-grown rhubarb.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha Erica Nic a’ Phearsain air ais a’ toirt cruth-atharrachadh àlainn air seòmaran agus toglaichean le a dealbhachadh sònraichte. Leanaidh sinn i bho thoiseach gu deireadh phròiseactan is sinn a’ faicinn gach pàirt den phròiseas, bho phlana air pàipear gu bhith a’ trusadh stuthan airson crìoch snasail a chur orra. Interior designer Erica MacPherson is back transforming rooms, homes and businesses. We follow her process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for finishing touches. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc: Calum starts his underground tour in the north west of Scotland. With help from local experts, he explores the incredible cave networks of Applecross. Looking at how man has harnessed underground resources, Calum explores the Nevis Tunnels, the aluminium smelter in Fort William and the globally unique Lochaline sand mine. Tha Calum a’ tòiseachadh air a thuras fon talamh ann an Iar-thuath na h-Alba. Le cuideachadh bho eòlaichean-uamha ionadail, rannsachaidh e lìonraidhean uamhan iongantach na Comraich. Chithear mar a tha mac an duine air feum a dhèanamh de ghoireasan fon talamh fhad ’s a nì Calum rannsachadh air Tunailean Nibheis agus leaghadair aluiminium a’ Ghearasdain, cho math ri mèinne gainmhich ann an Loch Àlainn a tha gun shamhail san t-saoghal. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke – An Còcaire Fiadhain – a’ rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha Liusaidh a’ toirt Màiri Anna dhachaigh gu dùthaich a h-òige, Shropshire, far an do thòisich a beatha an co-bhuinn ri nàdar. Tha iad a’ trusadh bhalgan-buachair nach gabh a lorg an Gàidhealtachd na h-Alba, agus a’ dèanamh picil leotha. Tha iad a’ beachdachadh air àrainneachd gu math eadar-dhealaichte bho an dachaigh an Alba le taic bho athair Liusaidh, a’ tadhal air darach a tha co-dhiù 800 bliadhn’ a dh’aois, agus a’ trusadh eidheann-thalmhainn, lus cùbhraidh a tha càirdeach do phionnd is sèids. Agus tha an còmhnaidh ùine ann airson basgaid ùir. Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke -forage for nature’s bounty. Lucy takes Mary Ann to Shropshire where she grew up and began her life in harmony with nature. They collect fungi that can’t be found in Highland Scotland and pickle them. With some help from Lucy’s dad, they visit an 800-year-old oak tree and forage for ground ivy, a fragrant herb related to mint and sage. And there’s always time for a new basket. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Caileag nan Eun
programme.desc: Tha Caitlin na boireannach òg a th’air a beò-ghlacadh le bhith a’ coimhead air eòin. Nuair a smaoineachas sinn air a’ chur-seachad seo is mathaid nach e òigridh a’ chiad fheadhainn a thig a-steach oirnn - ach tha Caitlin airson seo atharrachadh. Mar sin, tha i a’ falbh air turas mòr mun cuairt Alba, a shireadh daoine òga aig a bheil an aon ùidh rithe fhèin. Anns a’ phrògram seo cluinnear na sgeulachdan pearsanta acasan mu na buannachdan agus mun mhòr-thlachd a tha iad a’ faighinn às a’ chur-seachad iongantach seo. Caitlin is an avid birdwatcher, but as a young female, she goes against stereotype. Keen to connect with people who share her passion, she sets off on a road trip around Scotland to meet other birders who are defying the typecasts and to uncover some of the personal stories behind the hobby. Together, they share the joys and frustrations of birdwatching as well as the pure exhilaration in spotting a bird that means so much to them. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: A year after a major fire, archaeologists and scientists examine the battered stones of Notre-Dame in Paris.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le December ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform December in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un nuevo amanecer: Segunda parte
programme.desc: Pasífae pone sitio a la Atlántida y la ciudad parece a punto de caer. La última esperanza restante recae en Jasón, Hércules y Pitágoras, pero están librando una batalla propia.

programme.title: Atlantis: Telemón
programme.desc: Mientras Jasón lucha por la gloria en el campo del torneo, Ariadna se embarca en su propia batalla privada. El suyo es un concurso de cabeza sobre corazón, pero solo ella puede decidir cuál triunfará.

programme.title: Atlantis: El matrimonio de las mentes verdaderas
programme.sub-title: El matrimonio de las mentes verdaderas
programme.desc: A medida que avanzan los planes para la boda real, Ariadna debe emprender un viaje a Egina, la tierra natal de Telemon. Pero Jasón no es el único que teme por la seguridad de la reina.

programme.title: Atlantis: El día de los Muertos
programme.desc: La pandilla se encuentra dispersa alrededor de una antigua necrópolis. Y pronto se dan cuenta de que no están solos: el espacio está repleto de un ejército mágico de muertos vivientes.

programme.title: Atlantis: Las hermanas grises
programme.desc: Mientras Ariadna yace en su lecho de muerte, la culpa de Jasón es casi insoportable. Decide hacer todo lo posible para salvarla y se embarca en una peligrosa búsqueda hacia lo desconocido.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.sub-title: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.desc: Cuando la noticia llega a Pasífae sobre el inminente matrimonio de Ariadna y Jasón, está aterrorizada de que Atlantis se pierda para siempre y decide hacer todo lo posible para detener la unión.

programme.title: Atlantis: La locura de Hércules
programme.desc: A medida que Pasífae aumenta su control sobre la Atlántida, el futuro parece sombrío. Hércules sabe que solo hay una forma de salvar a sus amigos: Medusa. ¿Es un riesgo que está dispuesto a correr?

programme.title: Atlantis: La mirada de la Gorgona
programme.desc: Pasífae se ha apoderado de Atlantis y solo una cosa es segura: se necesitará un sacrificio de proporciones inimaginables para arreglar las cosas.

programme.title: Atlantis: La muerte de la luz
programme.desc: La profecía del Oráculo se ha hecho realidad: las revelaciones sobre Pasífae han ennegrecido el corazón de Jasón. Desesperado por salvar a su amigo, Pitágoras parte en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Atlantis: Familiares
programme.desc: Cuando nuestros héroes descubren que Jasón ha sido atrapado por las tropas de Pasífae, saben que deben hacer todo lo posible para rescatarlo antes de que se pierda para siempre.

programme.title: Atlantis: La reina debe morir - Parte 1
programme.desc: Jasón está decidido a rescatar a sus compañeros de prisión del anfiteatro. Pero esto significa volver a la Atlántida, el corazón del poder de Pasífae.

programme.title: Atlantis: La reina debe morir - Parte 2
programme.desc: Jasón está decidido a rescatar a sus compañeros de prisión del anfiteatro.

programme.title: Los Mosqueteros: Amigos y enemigos
programme.desc: Athos, Porthos y Aramis son enviados a encontrar a un mosquetero perdido. D'Artagnan busca venganza por la brutal muerte de un ser querido.

programme.title: Los Mosqueteros: Juego de manos
programme.desc: ¿Detendrán los mosqueteros al peligroso criminal que amenaza a la monarquía? ¿Probará D'Artagnan su valía?

programme.title: Los Mosqueteros: Materias primas
programme.desc: Los mosqueteros deben acompañar a un mercader de mala fama y a un explorador a París, mientras Athos se enfrenta con su pasado.

programme.title: Los Mosqueteros: El buen soldado
programme.desc: Aramis ve puesta a prueba su fidelidad con el ejército cuando acepta ayudar a un viejo amigo a descubrir la verdad detrás de una desastrosa misión.

programme.title: Los Mosqueteros: El regreso a casa
programme.desc: Phortos regresa a las peligrosas calles de su juventud cuando es injustamente acusado de asesinato. Es decisión de los otros mosqueteros rescatarlo o no.

programme.title: Secret Africa: Into the Wild Ep01
programme.desc: Lucy must adapt to life as a hunter-gatherer and earn the respect of the tribesmen, whose knowledge, skills and understanding of the land will be vital for the expedition ahead.

programme.title: The World's Deadliest Weather Ep06
programme.desc: In Germany, floods tear through central European towns and villages. In Nepal a landslide threatens local communities. In California, wildfires tear through the states forests and farms.

programme.title: Wilderness With Simon Reeve Ep02
programme.desc: Simon Reeve voyages across Mexico's beautiful and remote Sea of Cortez, known as the 'aquarium of the world,' to dive with rare and dangerous sharks.

programme.title: My Old School
programme.desc: In 1993, 16-year-old Brandon Lee enrolled at Bearsden Academy, a secondary school in a well-to-do suburb of Glasgow. What followed over the next two years would become the stuff of legend. Brandon had been privately tutored in Canada while he accompanied his mother - an opera diva - on tour before her tragic death. The preternaturally bright student surprised teachers by blazing toward his goal of entering medical school, displaying a wealth of knowledge beyond his years. Brandon found friends despite his initial awkwardness and took bullied students under his wing. He introduced classmates to seminal retro bands and even starred in the school's production of South Pacific - until his unbelievable secret was revealed. Film-maker Jono McLeod explores the strange story of Brandon Lee. Utilising playful, period-specific animation, a pitch-perfect soundtrack, the memories of students and teachers, and the talents of Alan Cumming and Lulu to bring the tale to life, this documentary offers more than one surprise along the way and finally reveals the truth behind one of the most incredible stories of the past 30 years.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: Birmingham has a big and very expensive housing problem. Many vulnerable people, including victims of domestic violence and those facing homelessness, are not getting the supported housing they’ve been promised and the government has paid for, leaving them even more at risk. Meanwhile, some of the housing providers and agents responsible are making big profits from taxpayers' money. Reporter Michael Buchanan meets residents who say they've been trapped in substandard accommodation, receiving little or no support, and traces those responsible. He also meets neighbours who are concerned about a rise in antisocial behaviour, speaks to charities and local politicians who are outraged at the misuse of public funds and asks: why is this housing rip-off being allowed to continue?

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The seasons are changing at Longmeadow, and Monty is planting spring-flowering bulbs to provide colour and interest in the months ahead. It’s also time to clear the greenhouse to make space for winter storage. Adam Frost visits RHS Harlow Carr to see how the newly renovated borders are flourishing. Arit Anderson talks to members of the Coco Collective, who grow and cook food from their inner-city allotment, and Sue Kent is at home creating a new planting scheme for next spring. In Oxfordshire, grower Andy Howard shares his passion for the heritage apples thriving in his back garden micro nursery.

programme.title: The Wonder of Animals
programme.desc: Chris Packham delves beneath a snake's skin to discover what has made them some of the most successful predators on earth. Their simple body plan hides remarkable adaptations that enable them to rival their limbed, winged and finned counterparts. Chris reveals the variety of ways in which snakes use their bodies not just to slither, but to climb, fly and swim. He explores how they use their senses to hunt, from heat-sensitive pits used to capture prey in the dark to tongues used to lure fish, and how venom acts not just to kill prey but also to predigest it.

programme.title: Carmen Jones
programme.desc: Bizet's evocative music blends with lyrics by Oscar Hammerstein II in this drama, set in mid-20th-century USA with an African-American cast. Carmen, a worker in a southern wartime parachute factory, falls in love with a soldier called Joe. When he kills his sergeant in a brawl, Joe and Carmen run away together, but soon, the woman tires of her guilty lover.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt

Christina takes a ride on the Bridgnorth Cliff Railway, one of England’s oldest and steepest funicular railways.

programme.title: Gymnastics World Championships

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Wallasey Town Hall on the banks of the River Mersey. Antiques experts Philip Serrell and Nick Davies get to meet people from all over Merseyside who have brought in their antiques and collectibles to receive a valuation. Paul gets special permission to go behind the scenes with National Museums Liverpool to find out how they preserve the millions of often priceless objects that are in their care at the Conservation Studios in the city centre. Paul also heads to the stately grandeur of Dunham Massey, which was a military hospital during the First World War. He explores an ambitious project which brings that significant time back to life.

programme.title: The Guns of Navarone
programme.desc: Explosive World War II action yarn in which a group of crack commandos are assembled for an apparently impossible mission. The team, made up of Allied and Greek soldiers with specialist talents, attempt to destroy the seemingly impregnable German artillery units on the Greek island of Navarone and in turn free 2,000 British soldiers on Kiros, an island in the Aegean.

programme.title: Amy Winehouse at the BBC
programme.desc: For the 20th anniversary of Amy Winehouse's stunning second album, Back to Black, this look through the BBC's extensive archives brings together a collection of memorable performances and rare interviews. Through these, Amy Winehouse's incredible talent can be seen, showcasing such hits as Rehab, Love Is a Losing Game and Stronger Than Me and celebrating the legacy of one of Britain's greatest singer-songwriters.

programme.title: Amy Winehouse: Back to Black at 20
programme.desc: Marking the 20th anniversary of Amy Winehouse’s album Back to Black, Jo Whiley welcomes a star-studded line-up of singers alongside The Amy Winehouse Band to perform each song from the record, live in a concert held at iconic music and arts venue the Roundhouse in Amy’s beloved Camden, north London. Joining The Amy Winehouse Band are special guests including Baby Rose, Corinne Bailey Rae, FLO, Jessie Reyez, Jorja Smith, Lianne La Havas, Nia Smith, Sasha Keable, Skye Newman, Terri Walker and Yebba, who all share their renditions of the tracks from the album. And Jo chats to some of the contributors about their love for Amy’s music and this seminal album, along with archive footage of Amy talking and performing.

programme.title: Amy Winehouse in Her Own Words
programme.desc: Portrait of Amy Winehouse through interviews and performances, some previously unseen. Including Glastonbury, Later...with Jools Holland and the Jazz and Soul Britannia series.

programme.title: Glastonbury
programme.desc: Amy Winehouse performs twice in one day at the festival in 2007, taking to the Pyramid Stage in the afternoon followed by an evening set on the then Jazz World Stage. Her seminal and big-selling Back to Black album had been released the autumn before and by the time of this festival had become a huge success. She and her band perform many of her classic tracks, including Tears Dry on Their Own, Back to Black and, of course, Rehab.

programme.title: In Ten Pictures
programme.desc: Amy Winehouse’s image is known around the world. She was the north London girl with a unique voice and look, who became hugely successful seemingly overnight, and whose private life the press became obsessed by. She died in 2011, aged just 27. This documentary throws a unique lens onto an extraordinary life, focusing on ten defining photographs - from iconic shots to private snaps – with the stories behind them revealed by those who were there and those who knew her best, including her parents and close friends.

programme.title: The Beasts
programme.desc: Middle-aged French couple Antoine and Olga have moved to an inland Galician hamlet, happy to live off the land and renovate some dilapidated properties, and intending to settle down, but a conflict with their neighbours reaches the point of no return. In French and Spanish with English subtitles

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: On the Northumberland coast, a 999 call comes in from a distressed woman whose husband is drifting out to sea on a paddleboard; the Seahouses crew race out to locate him. In Moelfre, north Wales, when a crew member at the station spots a kayak capsizing, the lifeboat launches to pluck the fishermen from the water. Out in the English Channel, a French vessel makes a distress call, alerting the Torbay crew. And in Calshot, Hampshire, a sailing sloop has become stuck on one of the area’s notorious mudbanks - and is now taking on water.

programme.title: DIY SOS
programme.desc: In Southampton, the team comes to the aid of Ahmed and Rifat, a profoundly deaf couple whose dream home became a nightmare after a rogue builder abandoned the project. With three young children, no savings left and living on a building site, they need help to complete their home and make it work for their family's needs. Nick and the team call on the local community to transform both the house and the family's future.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: Christine Walkden continues her airborne exploration of Britain's gardens by dropping in on the county of Essex. At the Beth Chatto Gardens, Christine experiments with triangular planting and shares tea and cake with a gardening legend. At RHS Hyde Hall, she shifts rocks with a former student, and it's all aboard a vintage Thames sailing barge for a trip on the Blackwater Estuary.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: How do you protect Britain’s busiest mountain when more than 600,000 people visit each year? Charlotte Smith and Joe Crowley head to Yr Wyddfa, Wales’s highest peak, to meet the people caring for its landscape and keeping visitors on the move. Joe joins volunteers tackling litter in some of the mountain’s hardest-to-reach gullies before discovering work to protect rare alpine plants and the elusive Snowdon beetle, found nowhere else in the UK. Meanwhile, Charlotte goes behind the scenes at Wales’s highest cafe to find out what it takes to keep visitors fed and watered at the summit. And Tom Heap investigates how organised crime gangs are targeting the countryside.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie heads west to the Morvern Peninsula in Lochaber to find out how Ardtornish Estate is being run to balance farming and stalking with nature restoration. Anne is on a photoshoot in Glenshee with a portrait photographer using Scotland’s landscape as her backdrop, and Leanna is near Kingussie encountering some misunderstood blood-sucking creatures that are being saved from extinction. Rosie visits the dairy farm near Peterhead that diversified and created new markets for their milk, and Dougie steps out with a herd of rare Irish cattle.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek gets some northern nostalgia as he remembers three of his best walks in north Wales. Cadair Idris is a mountain steeped in legend and mythology - it's also one of Wales's most spectacular summits. Derek climbs to three peaks in this range and even braves an icy cold dip in its glacial lake, where the temperature, quite literally, takes his breath away. The second walk Derek recalls is from the Italianate village of Portmeirion, where he also discovers Y Gwyllt - ‘the wild’ headland beyond. Finally, Derek walks the Dee Valley Way, a stunning 13-mile route which takes him from the pretty town of Corwen to its larger and more bustling neighbour, Llangollen. On the walk, he learns of a warrior prince and leads a horse-drawn barge along the Llangollen canal.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt brings an abundance of autumnal flavours to the table with help from some Saturday Kitchen chefs. Bryn Williams celebrates the best of the season's produce with a delicious butternut squash and chestnut tart, served with a winter salad and crispy deep-fried sage leaves. Selin Kaizim brings a taste of Cyprus to the studio with her beef and bulgur wheat koftes, while David Carter makes aubergines the stars of the show. Julie Lin makes a dish packed with crispy fried fish, cucumber, melted cheese, a punchy sambal and a side of crinkle-cut fries. Poppy O’Toole adds spices and harissa to a classic cottage pie base before topping with a fresh chilli and herb mash. And Bryan Cranston and Marianne Jean-Baptiste battle it out for their food heaven. Meanwhile, Rick Stein sets out to prove that old-fashioned veg is best, and the Hairy Bikers learn the history behind one of the world’s most famous condiments in Menorca.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva and her Breton guide Tanguy Thomassin explore the vast oyster beds of Cancale, oyster capital of Brittany. Being pummelled by one of the highest tides in Europe makes for fatter, sweeter and healthier oysters. And having once supplied King Louis XVI’s oyster habit, Brittany still supplies half of France. Bretons also boast of plentiful sardines, kelp forests, spiny crabs and the rare cobalt blue lobster. Fished sustainably and cooked on a grill, it's little wonder that this beauty is called the king of lobsters.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Multimillionaire landowner Paul Lister wants to turn his 23,000-acre estate north of Inverness into Europe's first wilderness reserve. Reinstating the old Caledonian pine forests is the first of his plans. He then wants to release long-lost animals, starting with moose and wild boar, and eventually predators such as brown bears, lynx and wolves. Some of the local people are far from convinced by Paul's vision. Will he even be allowed to let loose moose in the glen?

programme.title: Gymnastics World Championships
programme.desc: Coverage of the second part of the apparatus finals from Rotterdam, the Netherlands, featuring the men's vault, parallel bars and horizontal bars, and the women's balance beam and floor.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team are in Gloucester, where presenter Paul Martin and experts Phillip Serrell and Michael Baggott discover some rare gems among the antiques and collectibles brought to the valuation day at the city's magnificent cathedral.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: From the road trip back catalogue, three of Tim Medhurst's favourite pop stars try their hand at our antiques-buying challenge. Vying to be top of the pops are 90s heartthrob Peter Andre, the golden boy of the new romantics, Spandau Ballet's Martin Kemp, and an 80s pop icon, the mega-glamorous Sinitta. They are guided along the way by experts Paul Laidlaw, Margie Cooper, and the 'so macho' Tim Medhurst, helping them to hunt down timeless treasures. Sinitta lights up the saleroom with some illuminating items, Martin goes radio gaga, and Peter takes a punt on part of a plane!

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon Reeve travels across Mongolia – the most sparsely populated country on Earth and home to some of the most brutal and beautiful landscapes on the planet. Six times the size of the UK but with fewer than 3.5 million people, Simon wants to find out how nomadic traditions, such as hunting with golden eagles, and wild nature still shape everyday life, all while searching for the elusive snow leopard.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Sitting between Germany and France, Alsace is frontier land with a cuisine to match. In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer (brassier means ‘to brew’) and a deliciously creamy tarte flambee. Then there's a trip to guide Coralie Andt’s restaurant, known as a winstub, where French wines can be enjoyed with plenty of cheese and sausage – as well as more sausage with sauerkraut cooked in white Riesling wine. With French tarts in a brasserie that serves German-style beer, and German sausage in a winstub serving French white wine, Alsace is defined by its competing national influences.

programme.title: The Balkans: Europe’s Forgotten Frontier
programme.desc: Katya Adler travels to Romania, Kosovo and Serbia. In Romania, Katya visits what will soon be Nato’s largest base in Europe. With Russia’s increasing aggression, Nato’s role in eastern Europe has been beefed up, and Romania has become strategically significant. Katya’s next stop is Europe’s youngest country, Kosovo. She travels down Tony Blair Street – named after the UK prime minister who led the Nato mission there. Twenty-five years after the war ended, Katya meets the ethnic Serbs who still live in Kosovo – and insist the country is still Serbian. Lastly, in Serbia, she visits a coal power plant and discovers there’s a battle for power taking place, with the west, Russia and China all wanting Serbia to be in their sphere of influence. For decades, the west has ignored this corner of Europe, but now, with so many other parts of the world gaining power and influence, the fear is Europe might be losing its foothold in this increasingly important region.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob travel to the River Ribble in Lancashire for one last fish with their little canine pal, Ted. The beautiful river Ribble runs through the rolling hills of the Yorkshire Dales, onwards to Lancashire before meeting the Irish Sea in Lytham. With the river in good health, Paul and Bob hope to catch a good chub or a mighty barbel on this stretch of the water, while Ted hopes to taste Bob’s Lancashire hotpot.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Hollywood legend Bill Murray begins a journey around Ireland, combining golf with a search for his Irish roots. But travelling with Bill rarely goes to plan. In Kinsale, chance encounters turn a simple walk into an adventure, while friend and golf writer Tom Coyne tries to keep things on track. Golf brought Bill to Ireland, but the best moments often happen far from the course.

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Jools welcomes Dexys Midnight Runners, Courtney Barnett, Madra Salach, Ibibio Sound Machine, Mulaa Joans and Elkie Brooks to the show.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: Author Paul Sheldon is injured in a car accident on a remote snowy road. He is saved by nurse Annie Wilkes, a great fan of his work, but her devotion soon takes a sinister turn.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A gorgeous bride stood up at the altar as fiance a no-show, a blushing bride hauled off to the hospital on a gurney in her gown during her wedding reception, and a Vegas reverend posing as a rabbi. Dr. Phil talks with guests about wedding days from Hell.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Money is the number one reason why couples say they get divorced. The country's current financial crisis has resulted in more couples getting buried in a landslide of debt which takes its toll on a marriage. Is your marriage on the rocks because of debt?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shines a light on missing children. Some are taken by strangers, but more frequently a parent is the one to abduct them - too often with terrifying results. Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melisa says her estranged husband, Chris, is a pathological liar. Chris admits he has a problem with telling the truth and insists he wants to change -- but does he really? What's at the root of Chris' behavior? Should Melisa stay or call it quits?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How well do you know your teenager? Could your child be participating in risky or illegal activities right under your own roof?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Police Chief, His Wife, And His 6 Girlfriends Pt.1
programme.desc: A married Texas police chief is arrested after his multiple affairs are exposed online. Jason Collier admits to cheating with not one, but several women, all while married to, & living with his wife. Collier comes clean about his web of lies. Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Why Is My Mom Faking Cancer?
programme.desc: Jessica says mom Patricia says she is defying odds becoming a record-setting weight lifter while simultaneously battling Stage 3 brain cancer. Jessica insists her mom isn't sick at all & she is lying about her health to gain sympathy. Emotions run high!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Doctor, His Wife, The Mistress, The Murder
programme.desc: Gypsy Willis, a former mistress of a Utah doctor convicted in the 2007 murder of his wife, speaks out about the case & controversies that surround her. Why did she move into MacNeill's home 9 days after his wife's death? Does Gypsy feel he was wronged?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Revenge: The Good, The Bad, And The Ugly Pt.1
programme.desc: "Bleach, Keys, Bologna": all used as retaliation weapons. Dr. Phil, criminal atty Anthony Pope, & revenge expert Dr. Gina Barreca discuss--such as use of superglue on a man's private parts & also, Michael Brewer, 15, badly burned over a stolen bike. Pt.1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Whatever Happened To...(Most Talked About Guests)
programme.desc: Do you ever wonder how your favorite Dr. Phil guest is faring since being on the show? Dr. Phil follows up with some of his most talked about guests.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Adult Brother Is A Loser Living In His Childhood Bedroom
programme.desc: At age 45, Jeff moved back into his childhood bedroom in his mother's home & has reverted to a high schooler, for 16 years. Jeff's daughter, Tori, says her dad is a terrible father, an immature coward. Jeff comes face-to-face with his fed-up family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Good, The Bad, And Wanda's Bi-Polar Pt.2
programme.desc: Things heat up as Tiffany's brother accuses mom Wanda of stealing his wife's wedding rings! Plus, find out what Tiffany says to cause her dad to jump out of his seat in the audience & make his way to stage. Can Dr. Phil help this family communicate? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Subway Sandwich King To Child Sex Scandal: Jared Fogle Pt.1
programme.desc: Former Subway spokesman Jared Fogle caught on tape. Listen to the shocking, never-before-heard audio recordings. Former journalist Rochelle Herman-Walrond secretly taped the pitchman for years as part of the FBI's investigation. Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: All My Ex Cares About Is Acting & Singing For The Lord Pt.1
programme.desc: Danielle & Brandon are in a custody war over their little daughter. Mom Danielle has visitation, & says her ex has threatened to kill her twice. Dad Brandon says Danielle is a terrible mother concerned with her 'nonexistent' acting/singing career. Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: During tough financial times, families face some of the biggest pressures. When parents are on edge and fighting with each other, children are often a casualty of their hostility.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Our Daughter Is Starving Herself: Can Jordan Be Saved? Pt.2
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Jordan, who has an eating disorder & weighs 75 pounds . Find out why Jordan's parents despise her boyfriend & they meet him on stage. Plus, Cleveland kidnapping survivor Michelle Knight reveals all the details of her wedding. Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's hard to believe, but in America alone, there may be as many as 5,000 religious groups preying upon the weak and vulnerable, and all in the name of God. Dr. Phil's guests have warnings for you and your children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl (7)
programme.desc: Pumuckl und Eder gehen Angeln. Pumuckl ist ganz aufgeregt. Einen Fisch hat er noch nie gefangen! Doch sie sind nicht die einzigen Münchner, die es am Wochenende aufs Land zieht. In der langen Schlange am Kiosk verliert Pumuckl die Geduld. Auf Koboldsart schafft er es, dass Eder schneller an die Angelkarte kommt als gedacht. Und der bekommt von der Verkäuferin auch noch einen Geheimtipp für ein angeblich ruhiges Plätzchen. Vergnügt nascht Pumuckl Himbeeren vom Strauch, während sie sich durchs Unterholz durchschlagen. Am malerischen Steg angekommen, genießen sie die Ruhe. Doch diese wird bald gestört. Eine laute Hundebesitzerin, ein Taucher in Eders Angelschnur, ein hungriger Hund und streitende Kinder trüben die Idylle. Eder ist kurz davor, frustriert das Angeln aufzugeben, als Pumuckl plötzlich einen riesigen Fisch am Haken hat! Doch der ist viel größer und stärker als der Kobold. Pumuckl wird auf den See hinausgezogen. Der Kobold schwebt in Lebensgefahr! Eder kann ihn in letzter Sekunde retten. Aber Pumuckl hat den Fisch gefangen! Er ist mächtig stolz darauf. Doch was der Eder als nächstes mit dem Fisch vorhat, behagt dem Kobold so gar nicht. Er hat Mitleid mit dem Tier. Wie zufällig stößt er den Eimer um, sodass der Fisch entkommen kann. Und so kehren sie am Abend zwar ohne Fisch nach Hause zurück. Aber dafür mit den Taschen voll frischer Himbeeren, die sie sich schmecken lassen.
